provenance.not_covered: The rungs, the build procedure, the render check and the lint rules.

scenes.narration: The prompt `/explain` takes a subject. It makes an artifact that must pass four checks before handoff.

cites.snippet: the four checks an explain artifact must pass before handoff

scenes.narration: The artifact is a sheet, a page or a video. We follow a page through the checks.

cites.snippet: of the rung passed (sheet, page: four; lesson: five; video: three)

scenes.narration: The check script reads one file. That file is `index.html`.
It prints one line for each check, in order. First comes self-contained, then render, citations and prose.

cites.snippet: stdout carries one line per check, in this order

scenes.narration: The citations check reads the cited line of the source file. Here the source is `cite_check.py`.

cites.snippet: Exit 0 when every citation holds, 1 with one failure per line

scenes.narration: The snippet must be on that line. If one word is different, the check fails.

cites.snippet: snippet not found on that line

scenes.narration: The prose check reads each sentence. A descriptive sentence has at most 25 words.
Every check runs, even after a failure. When all checks pass, the artifact is ready.

cites.snippet: Every check runs even after an earlier one failed.
